extracted.name: Chipotle Sauce
extracted.description: This smoky chipotle sauce is very quick and easy to make with just 3 ingredients: plain yogurt, mayo, and chipotle peppers in adobo sauce.
ingredient_lines: 2 teaspoons pureed chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
instruction_lines: Mix yogurt, mayonnaise, and chipotle peppers together in a small bowl until smooth. Chill until serving.
